user.title: Calorie Tracker
user.description: Optional: paste a MyFitnessPal session cookie to import your foods, meals, recipes and diary history. Open a private browser window and log in to MyFitnessPal, open developer tools → Storage/Application → Cookies, copy the value of `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`, then close the private window without logging out. Do not reuse this cookie anywhere else: MyFitnessPal revokes sessions whose cookie is reused.

reauth_confirm.title: MyFitnessPal session expired
reauth_confirm.description: The MyFitnessPal session ended. Open a private browser window and log in to MyFitnessPal, open developer tools → Storage/Application → Cookies, copy the value of `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`, then close the private window without logging out. Do not reuse this cookie anywhere else: MyFitnessPal revokes sessions whose cookie is reused.

tdee.title: Adaptive TDEE and scale
tdee.description: Optional Calculations-sheet model. Select your own BodyMiScale user, or a personal weight sensor. BodyMiScale handles identification on shared scales. Starting weight/body fat stay fixed; change the weekly goal any time. Completed weeks with at least four logged calorie days calibrate TDEE; up to three days may be missing. Automatic targets are a separate opt-in.

data.tdee_auto_goals: Automatically use calculated calorie and macro goals
data.tdee_initial_weight: Starting weight in kg (optional; otherwise captured from scale)
data.tdee_initial_body_fat: Starting body fat in % (optional with a body-fat sensor)
data.tdee_start_date: Starting date (optional; otherwise first accepted measurement)
data.tdee_weekly_goal: Weekly weight change in kg (negative = lose, positive = gain)
